SELECT a.tenant_id, b.tenant_name as tenantName, c.industry_name, a.app_ver_code, a.vehicle_number, a.valid_period, d.vehicle_name as vehicleName, a.load_weight, a.creator, a.modifier, a.create_time, a.update_time, CONCAT(IFNULL(e.area_name, ''),IFNULL(f.area_name, ''),IFNULL(g.area_name, '')) AS administrativeArea FROM vm_checkpoint_vehicle_license_plate_t a LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_info b ON a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf c on a.industry_code = c.industry_code and c.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN vm_checkpoint_vehicle_type_t d on a.vehicle_type = d.vehicle_type and d.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area e ON a.province_code = e.area_code AND e.status = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area f ON a.city_code = f.area_code AND f.status = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area g ON a.county_code = g.area_code AND g.status = 0
a.delete_flag =0 AND c.accept_node = #{acceptNode} AND a.black_or_white = #{blackOrWhite} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND a.vehicle_number like concat('%',#{vehicleNumber},'%') AND a.vehicle_type = #{vehicleType} AND a.creator like concat('%',#{creator},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTimeStart}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.modifier like concat('%',#{modifier},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{updateTimeStart}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{updateTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
ORDER BY a.create_time ASC
ORDER BY a.update_time ASC
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
ORDER BY a.update_time DESC
